routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of about 90 countries enter without a visa. Most get 30 days, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, Korea, Türkiye and all of the EU and Schengen area. Several ex-Soviet states get unlimited stay.

other: Unlimited stay: Azerbaijan, Georgia, Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Moldova, Russia, Ukraine.
60 days: Kyrgyzstan. 30 days: Tajikistan.
10 days: China (Hong Kong and Macao). China mainland gets 30 days.
30 days with an air ticket: Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman.
India: 30 days from 1 Sep 2026 only with a valid multiple-entry business or tourist visa of the US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan, Korea or a Schengen state, plus an air ticket.
Check the official list for every country.

stay.note: 30 days is the standard. Clock starts at the border. Leave when it ends or get a visa.

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Electronic visa (e-visa)
routes.summary: Online visa for citizens of 55 listed countries that are not visa-free, such as India, Saudi Arabia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam and Colombia. Single, double and multiple entry, up to 30 days.

other: Only for countries on the official e-visa list (Annex 1).
The MFA can restrict e-visas of up to 30 days for some countries.

steps: Pick nationality and purpose, then dates
Enter personal data and upload a photo and passport page
Confirm your email with the code
Get the e-visa PDF by email
documents: Passport data page scan under 500 KB
routes.processing: Result is sent by email. No time frame stated on the portal.

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan
Official e-visa portal: what you need to know

routes.name: Tourist visa (T)
routes.summary: Regular consular tourist visa, up to 1 month. Group visas (TG) need 5 or more people.
documents: Passport valid at least 3 months beyond the visa
routes.processing: Invitation requests are handled by the MFA within 4 working days.

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Business visa (B-2)
routes.summary: Business visit visa for up to 1 year. Needs an invitation from a registered company approved by the MFA.

other: Invitation from a legal entity registered in Uzbekistan, approved by the MFA

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Transit visa and visa-free airport transit
routes.summary: Transit visa for up to 3 days. Citizens of 47 countries in Annex 2 (including India, Mexico, Colombia, Thailand, Saudi Arabia, South Africa) can stay up to 5 days visa-free when transiting with an Uzbekistan Airways ticket to a third country.

other: Transit visa needs a visa for the final destination and a ticket showing departure date.
Visa-free 5-day transit: Annex 2 countries only, Uzbekistan Airways ticket required.

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Visa at Tashkent airport (pre-approved)
routes.summary: If Uzbekistan has no embassy in your country, an inviter in Uzbekistan can get MFA approval first. You show it when you fly and get the visa at Tashkent airport.

other: Only for citizens of countries without an Uzbek mission
Invitation approval from the MFA is required before you travel

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Work visa (E)
routes.summary: Work entry visa for the period your right to work is confirmed. You need that confirmation from the labor ministry's external labor migration agency first.

other: Confirmation of the right to work from the External Labour Migration Agency
Invitation from an employer, approved by the MFA

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Student visa (A-1)
routes.summary: Study visa for up to 1 year, requested by the school. Exchange students get STD. Teachers get A-2 and visiting researchers A-3 (3 months to 2 years).

other: Processed on request of the educational institution

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Investor visa (INV)
routes.summary: Multiple-entry visa up to 3 years, extendable without leaving. For people who buy shares or stakes worth at least 8,500 times the base calculation amount, or set up a company with foreign investment. Spouse, parents and children get matching visitor visas.

other: Minimum is 8,500 times the base calculation amount. The current base amount in UZS was not checked.
Certificate of shares or stakes from the Central Securities Depository or Public Services Agency
Inviting company must have foreign investment

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: IT visa
routes.summary: Multiple-entry visa up to 3 years, extendable inside Uzbekistan. For IT investors and specialists recommended by the IT Park, founders of IT Park residents, startup founders in the Digital Start-ups Programme, and IT professors with a PhD or DSc.

other: Needs a recommendation from the IT Park directorate

sources.label: MFA Uzbekistan: Visa to the Republic of Uzbekistan

routes.name: Golden Visa (5-year residence permit)
routes.summary: Simplified 5-year residence permit for investors, in place since June 2025 under a presidential decree. Reported cost is 250,000 USD for the investor and 150,000 USD per family member.

investment.note: 150,000 USD per spouse, child or parent

other: Source is an embassy news item describing the decree, not the decree text. Check the rules before you rely on it.

sources.label: Embassy of Uzbekistan in Pakistan: Golden Visa program

routes.name: Permanent residence (ID card for permanent residents)
routes.summary: The law lets foreigners live permanently in Uzbekistan and get a permanent resident ID card, valid 5 years for ages 16 to 60. How to qualify was not found on the official pages read.

other: Route and years of residence not confirmed. Card can be canceled after more than 3 years away without valid reasons.
